title: Healing the Man with a Withered Hand
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Children who are abled differently are included and never pointed at; prayer for healing is shared only if a child wishes.

skills.key_step: The child retells the healing of the man with a withered hand (Matthew 12:9-13) and says we should show compassion.

floor.question: What illness did Simon's mother-in-law have?

representations: a drawing of a sheep in a pit
steps: Say why it was right to heal.
contexts: a classmate who is abled differently

board.say: What happened when the man obeyed?

board.do: Wait for the child to say his hand was healed.

misconceptions.ask: What was wrong with the man?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture and read Matthew 12:10.

misconceptions.ask: Was it right for Jesus to heal on the Sabbath?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 12:11-12: the sheep in a pit.

misconceptions.ask: How did Jesus heal the hand?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 12:13 and act it out.

checks.question: What did Jesus tell the man?
